title.narrative: Jiangxi Wuxikou Integrated Flood Management Project

description.narrative: The development objective of the Jiangxi Wuxikou Integrated Flood Management Project for China is to reduce the flood risk in the central urban area of Jingdezhen city through implementation of priority structural and non-structural measures, and contribute to establishment of an integrated flood risk management system for the city. There are four components to the project. The first component of the project is construction of Wuxikou flood control scheme. This component includes: acquisition and installation of electro-mechanical equipment of five radial gates, and implementation of the Environmental and Social Management Plan (ESMP). The second component of the project is capacity building for integrated flood risk management system. This component includes: preparation of a master plan of integrated flood risk management for Jingdezhen city, and provision of equipment for a municipal flood control and dispatching center, including essential operation equipment to facilitate efficient functioning of the municipal flood management system. The third component of the project is implementation of resettlement action plan. This component includes: investment in resettlement, investment in special infrastructure, and reallocation of effected section of railway. The fourth component of the project is project management and implementation support. This component includes: provision of consulting services to enhance engineering design, construction supervision, dam safety and environmental and social management, including the formation and maintenance of a dam safety panel of experts, and acquisition of office equipment and vehicles, and provision of operating resources.

To reduce the flood risk in the central urban area of Jingdezhen City through implementation of priority structural and non-structural measures, and contribute to establishment of an integrated flood risk management system for the City.

Finance Agreement :PA, Schedule, Section I, Part C, para 17 | Description :Annual Work Plan: Jingdezhen City to prepare and provideto the Bank for review and comments the annual work plan for implementation of the project, including activities drawn from thePIP, the EMP, the RAP, the RPF, the PMP and DSR.Monitoring and Evaluation Plan: Jingdezhen City to prepare and provide to the Bankthe annual monitoring and evaluation plan for review and comments. | Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :PA, Schedule, Section I, Part C, para 7 | Description :Jingdezhen City to engage and retain the services ofindependent consultants to carry out external monitoring and reporting on implementation of the EMP, RAP and RPF annually andimplement the recommended measures in a prompt and efficient manner satisfactory to the Bank, in order to improve compliance withthe EMP, RAP and RPF. Same applies to Dam Safety Panel on design reports & Dam Safety Plans | Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :PA, Schedule, Section II, Part A, para 1 | Description :Jingdezhen City to monitor and evaluate the progress ofthe Project according to the agreed annual work plan and prepare Progress Reports for the Project, including activities drawn fromthe PIP, the EMP, the RAP, the RPF, the PMP and DSR. Each such Project Report shall cover the period of one calendar semester, andbe furnished to the Bank by Mar 15 and Sep 15 each year, starting on Mar 15,2013 | Frequency :Yearly

Finance Agreement :PA, Schedule, Section II, Part A, para 2 | Description :Jingdezhen City to, not later than June 30, 2015, reviewwith the Bank (mid-term review) the progress made in the implementation ofthe Project, together with any recommendation theBorrower or the Bank may have on measures to be taken to ensure the efficient completion of the Project and to achieve theobjectives thereof. | Due Date :30-Jun-2015

Finance Agreement :PA, Schedule, Section II, Part B, para 4 | Description :Jingdezhen City to install and operationalize for usethe Procurement and Financial Management Information System no later than thirty (30) days after the Effective Date, and thereafterapply the system in order to monitor the entire procurement process and financial transactions under the Project in a mannersatisfactory to the Bank. | Frequency :CONTINUOUS

Finance Agreement :Project Agreement (PA), Schedule, Section I, Part A. title.narrative: 11: No. of people relocated with proper compensation and livelihood restoration

comment.narrative: <p>Completion of this indicator is a precondition for the construction of the reservoir. The livelihood restoration programs enhance the long-term social sustainability of this indicator, which contributes to both PDO (a) and (b).</p>

title.narrative: 14: No. of staff from PMO and related bureaus (including decision makers) attend trainings and study tours (both domestic and off-shore) and pass test on project management and flood risk Mgt

comment.narrative: <p>Completion of the target value of this indicator contributes to capacity building on project management.</p>

title.narrative: Generation Capacity of Hydropower constructed or rehabilitated under the project

comment.narrative: <p>Completion of the target tracks the progress of constructing the hydropower plant, which provide economic and climate co-benefits of this project. </p>

title.narrative: 12: No. of people whose land was levied and properly compensated

comment.narrative: <p>Completion of this indicator ensures the social risks associated with the project are sufficiently mitigated, which contributes to both PDO (a) and (b).</p>
<p>Achievement of this indicator provide environmental and social co-benefits by ensuring minimum environmental flow in the downstream Changjiang River and providing water supplies to Jingdezhen.</p>

title.narrative: PO-2: The flood protection level is increased from 20-year flood to 50-year flood

comment.narrative: <p>Completion of this target has reduced flood risk in Jingdezhen Municipality, which contributes to both PDO (a) and (b)</p>

title.narrative: PO-1: Percentage of urban population protected from 1-in 50-year floods (disaggregated by gender)

comment.narrative: <p>Completion of this target has ensured people's livelihood is protected as a priority of flood management, which contributes to both PDO (a) and (b)</p>

title.narrative: PO-3: Total area subject to inundation by 1-in-50 year floods

comment.narrative: <p>Completion of this target has reduced economic losses and disruptions to people's lives in Jingdezhen Municipality, which contributes to both PDO (a) and (b)</p>

title.narrative: 9: No. of people participating in the flood-risk management and answered the flood-risk awareness questionnaire (disaggregated by Gender)

comment.narrative:
<p>???????</p>

<p>Completion of this indicator increases people's flood awareness and preparedness, which complements the structural measures and DSS. However, there was an error regarding the indicator definition as it is unrealistic to have 0.22 million people answering the questionnaire. After clarifying with the PMO and the task team, the indicator was meant to evaluate the number ofpeople who have participated in flood-risk management, including, instead of and, those who have answered the questionnaire.</p>

title.narrative: 10: Operation & Maintenance Plan for DSS gets approved by Jingdezhen municipal government

comment.narrative: <p>Completion and approval of the O&M plans ensure that the DSS developed under the project can be fully operational even after the project closure, which contributes to the long-term sustainability of the PDO (b)</p>

title.narrative: 6: Operation & Maintenance Plan for Wuxikou Flood Control Scheme gets approved by Jingdezhen municipal government

comment.narrative: <p>Completion and approval of the O&M plans ensure that the works completed under the project, Wuxikou Flood Control Scheme, are well maintained and repaired for sustainable operations to deliver flood protection benefits to the beneficiaries, which contributes to PDO (a).</p>
